item.text: {"search_note":"There is some evidence of formal oversight still functioning in 2024, especially the Election Commission and Supreme Court. The stronger pattern is negative: pressure on civil society, press, and information channels; attempts to create a government fact-checking unit; and persistent allegations around opaque finance and Adani. I did not find a clean 2024 source showing Modi personally welcomed independent investigations into his own conduct or assets.
